reason: Prepare the sample carrier for transferring the two frozen cores to flight cooling.
expectation: I expect the cold transfer bench to ready the carrier for the cores, though the exact preparation is unclear.

alternatives.reason: The first specimen also needs securing, but I chose to prepare the core transfer first.

effect: The chilled carrier has room for both complete core liners, so I can begin loading them.
reaction: The attention to preserving the surrounding ice is reassuring.
reason: Load the stored source core into the conditioned carrier for flight.
expectation: I expect the source core to be secured in one chilled cradle, leaving room for the other core.

alternatives.reason: The membrane also needs securing, but I will load the cores first.

effect: The source core is loaded, and the second chilled compartment remains empty.
reaction: The separate compartments make the transfer easy to follow.
reason: Load the articulated body's core into the remaining compartment.
expectation: I expect the complete second core liner to join the source core in the carrier.

alternatives.reason: The membrane also needs securing, but I want to finish loading the cores first.

effect: Both core liners are packed separately in the carrier and ready for flight cooling.
reaction: Seeing the folded outline again makes the transfer feel consequential.
reason: Connect the packed cores to the refrigerated flight bay to secure their cooling.
expectation: I expect both cores to be placed on flight cooling while remaining in their separate cradles.

alternatives.reason: The first specimen also needs securing, but I want to complete the cores' cold transfer first.

effect: Both cores are secured on active flight cooling; the first membrane specimen remains to be stowed.
reaction: The transfer buffer bridging the cooling changeover is a satisfying practical detail.
reason: Secure the remaining specimen in the flight locker; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the membrane specimen to be secured for the journey, completing its goal.

effect: The membrane is secured separately, completing both specimen-transfer goals.
reaction: The padded restraint and separate locker make the final stowage feel suitably careful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the packed cores to flight cooling was the most worthwhile moment: the buffer provided a concrete explanation of how their cold chain survived the transfer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the two cores in succession felt a little repetitive, though their separate cradles made the procedure clear.

surprise.text: The carrier held both complete liners, preserving the surrounding ice rather than just the visible specimens.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each had a clear role in preparing, transferring or securing the specimens.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the laboratories discover, although this chapter's compatible-action menu made the transfer more procedural than challenging.
